items.title: Apollo Global Management (APO) Stock Looks Below Fair Value After Record Origination
items.summary: Apollo Global Management has delivered a 71.5% total return over the past 5 years, yet the current share price near US$116.75 raises a simple question for you as an investor. Are you paying a fair price for what the business actually earns on the capital it puts to work? A 71.5% gain over 5 years means long term holders have already seen a lot of value created, so the issue now is whether future returns on Apollo Global Management’s capital can support the current valuation.
